title: Striped Ruffle Cardigan – Big Collar – Fuchsia & Pink

seo.title: Striped Ruffle Cardigan, S/M | Isar Things
seo.description: Fuchsia and pink striped cardigan with a big collar, ruffle hem and cuffs and gold buttons. Size S/M, new with tags, only one piece.

descriptionHtml:
Fuchsia and candy-pink stripes, an oversized pointed collar and little ruffles at the hem and cuffs: this cardigan is pure joy. Gold-tone buttons down the front, soft brushed knit, fitted silhouette. Wear it buttoned up as a top or open over a white tee with your favourite jeans.

Made for every body and every style, because at Isar no piece has just one way to be worn.

Details

  • Brand new with tags
  • Colour: fuchsia and pink stripes, pink collar and ruffles
  • Size: S/M
  • Material: 60% polyester, 19% polyamide, 15% acrylic, 6% wool
  • Fit: regular, slightly cropped
